name: Aiven MCP Server
description: Lets AI assistants provision and operate Aiven-managed PostgreSQL and Apache Kafka, running SQL, producing and consuming messages, and diagnosing services from metrics and logs.

skills.name: PostgreSQL Operations
skills.description: Runs SQL and manages schemas, indexes, extensions, and pgvector on Aiven-managed PostgreSQL.

skills.name: Kafka Topic Produce And Consume
skills.description: Creates topics, produces and consumes messages, and checks consumer group lag and offsets on managed Kafka.

skills.name: Service Diagnostics
skills.description: Pulls CPU and memory metrics and service logs, and uses pg_stat_statements and EXPLAIN to find slow queries.

skills.name: Read-Only And Scoped Access
skills.description: Limits the exposed tools by service scope, read-only mode, and a write allowlist set on the server URL.
